what: WT-34 (PB-0) readings: GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 TP4, U4 (ISL 13312 / OSL 33), stream_interval 20, 4 arms per job, 3 jobs. Derived from the probe's wt34_analyze.py output by make_records_readings.py (both in the local evidence directory named in README.md).

points.name: http
points.what: HTTP handler entered (openai_server.openai_completion)

points.name: pre_submit
points.what: input processed, generate_async about to be called

points.name: submitted
points.what: generate_async returned in the front end

points.name: f_call
points.what: front end about to issue the gRPC Generate call (first __anext__)

points.name: s_rpc
points.what: servicer Generate entered

points.name: s_submit
points.what: servicer about to call the engine's generate_async

points.name: s_submitted
points.what: engine generate_async returned in the servicer

points.name: w_submit
points.what: rank-0 worker submit() entered

points.name: w_enqueued
points.what: rank-0 worker enqueued the request to the executor

points.name: e_activate
points.what: executor activated the request (fetched from the waiting queue)

points.name: e_first_ctx
points.what: first iteration scheduled with a context chunk of the request

points.name: e_last_ctx
points.what: last iteration scheduled with a context chunk of the request

points.name: e_first_rsp
points.what: executor about to enqueue the request's first response

points.name: w_first_rsp
points.what: rank-0 worker received the first response from the executor (before dispatch)

points.name: s_first_result
points.what: servicer got the first result from the engine's result handle

points.name: s_first_yield
points.what: servicer about to yield the first token response to gRPC ("first output leaves")

points.name: f_first_token
points.what: front end received the first token event ("first output arrives")

points.name: p_first_out
points.what: openai_server got the first output from generate_async's result

points.name: p_first_chunk
points.what: openai_server about to yield the first SSE chunk

points.name: ttft
points.what: client first token (reqlog ttft)

points.name: w_final_rsp
points.what: rank-0 worker received the final response from the executor (before dispatch)

points.name: p_last_out
points.what: openai_server finished yielding the chunks of the last output

points.name: latency
points.what: client end-to-end latency

segments.name: from_engine
segments.what: executor first response -> client first token

segments.name: grpc_req
segments.what: front end Generate call -> servicer Generate entered

segments.name: servicer_out
segments.what: executor first response -> servicer about to yield it

segments.name: grpc_rsp
segments.what: servicer about to yield -> front end receives (gRPC response leg)

segments.name: frontend_out
segments.what: front end receives -> client first token

note_nulls: Points and segments that only the chain arms have are null for the in-process arms and pairs.
